//: Turning checkJs on across the whole tree reports 2,845 errors, and almost
none of them are defects: they are the checker not knowing that a
querySelector returned an HTMLElement, or that window.tulip exists. A gate
nobody can turn green is not a gate.
So checkJs is off, and a file opts in by starting with `// @ts-check`. Fifty
already do — every store that writes to disk, the preload that is the
renderer's whole view of the outside world, and the pure-logic modules where
a wrong argument is a real bug. The list only grows: clean up a file's types,
add the marker, and it can never regress.
